title: Levels
text: Settings → Levels shows four columns: #, MODEL (base ID and display name), MIN EFFORT and NOW, plus Launchable on harness chips. Levels rows are configured through the CLI. A separate Cursor quota order panel has exactly two editable monthly-pool rows; no per-project next-launch summary is shown.
evidence: Production launch.622: QA run 45473 / artifact 32323, captured 2026-10-13; 4 levels, 18 rows, 16 headers, 2 quota rows and move controls, zero level-next-launch summaries.
